_comment: app0:/mkxp.json — the VPK author's pin (CWD starts at SDL_GetBasePath = app0:/).
This is the PRODUCT config, and the product is the
LAUNCHER: gameFolder and customScript are EMPTY on purpose, which is what
makes vita_boot_mode_from() draw the game list instead of starting a game
(vita/docs/launcher.md). The bubble scans vitaGamesRoot, starts a picked game
with --game and returns to the list when the game exits.
To ship a PINNED player instead, do not edit this file: point the packager
at another root config, e.g. MKXP_JSON=<config> TITLE_ID=<test id>
vita/scripts/package-vpk.sh (a pinned package needs a test TITLE_ID).
Keys/types must match ConfDef at mkxp-z 826929ee. Stock load order applies
(src/config.cpp Config::read): this file, chdir gameFolder, readGameINI(),
then customDataPath/mkxp.json. The config layers sit underneath it; with
vitaConfigLayers true every game started from the list also reads
app0:/config/default.json (the device profile),
ux0:/data/mkxp-z/config.json and the game's own mkxp.json first. Full load
order, every key and the pinned-player rules: vita/docs/config.md.
preloadScript in THIS file runs natively before the game's own scripts, with
the game folder as the working directory, so its entry is an absolute app0:
path. Preload lists in a game's own mkxp.json or mkxp-vita.json are resolved
by win32_wrap.rb instead, relative to the game folder (vita/docs/config.md).
enableSettings gates Start and F1 for the Vita overlay menu; product
packages pin true. The packager composes the packaged preload additions
into vitaPackagePreloads; keep win32_wrap.rb on preloadScript.
